heroes.name: Bebop

heroes.name: Shiv
heroes.tagline: Bleeds out foes, then goes in for a kill

heroes.name: Ivy

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.quip: Throw a barrel that explodes when shot
abilities.description: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage , setting enemies on fire and applying knockup . The barrel can be detonated early by being shot , melee'd , or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.
upgrades: +40 Impact Damage +13.33 Burn Damage per Second -5 s Charge Time Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Bounce Pad
abilities.quip: Send yourself and others flying
abilities.description: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero . You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
upgrades: You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing

abilities.name: Spirit Lasso
abilities.quip: Grab an enemy and drag them behind you
abilities.description: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage , pulling , and applying stun . Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

abilities.name: Crackshot
abilities.quip: Deal bonus damage with headshots
abilities.description: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty . This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.
upgrades: -6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.quip: Charge into the fray, dragging enemies along
abilities.description: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun . If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
upgrades: -18s Cooldown On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6 s

abilities.name: Infernal Resilience
abilities.quip: Regenerate some of the damage you receive
abilities.description: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

abilities.name: Seismic Impact
abilities.quip: Smash into enemies from above, stunning them
abilities.description: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun .
upgrades: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.quip: Drain health from nearby enemies
abilities.description: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
upgrades: +2m Radius and +18 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
abilities.quip: Punch someone away from you
abilities.description: Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback . When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.quip: Plant a bomb on an enemy
abilities.description: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills
upgrades: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

abilities.name: Hyper Beam
abilities.quip: Unleash a massive damaging beam
abilities.description: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow .
upgrades: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero

abilities.name: Grapple Arm
abilities.quip: Pull in a target to you
abilities.description: Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

abilities.name: Pulse Grenade
abilities.quip: Throw a grenade that pulses, dealing damage and time slowing
abilities.description: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage , time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.
upgrades: +20 Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Time Wall
abilities.quip: Create a wall that greatly slows projectiles
abilities.description: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed .

abilities.name: Kinetic Carbine
abilities.quip: Charge up your weapon to deal high damage and timestop
abilities.description: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage . Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
upgrades: +2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling

abilities.name: Paradoxical Swap
abilities.quip: Swap positions with an enemy hero.
abilities.description: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.
upgrades: 200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage

abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
abilities.quip: Release a ground pulse that knocks enemies into the air
abilities.description: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup .
upgrades: On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s

abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
abilities.quip: Blink in and out of existence
abilities.description: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. : Bring nearby allies with you.
upgrades: Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50% Replenishes 1 Charge

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
abilities.quip: Heal yourself and those around you
abilities.description: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
upgrades: Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.quip: Pull in and stun the enemy team
abilities.description: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time , applying stun , and pulling in nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Medicinal Specter
abilities.quip: Deploy a healing spirit
abilities.description: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
upgrades: +2% Max HP Regen +3m Heal Radius +40% Spirit Resist

abilities.name: Mini Turret
abilities.quip: Deploy an automated turret
abilities.description: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time . The turret expires after a limited lifetime. Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
upgrades: +25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime

abilities.name: Spectral Wall
abilities.quip: Conjure a wall to block your foes
abilities.description: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
upgrades: Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s +24% Slow

abilities.name: Heavy Barrage
abilities.quip: Bombard an area with rockets
abilities.description: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.
upgrades: Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling

abilities.name: Essence Bomb
abilities.quip: Sacrifice some health to launch a damaging bomb
abilities.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
upgrades: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30% of the original damage per second , for 6s .

abilities.name: Malice
abilities.quip: Stack damage amplification on an enemy
abilities.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.quip: Steal health from an enemy over time
abilities.description: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you . Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. to give health to friendly Heroes .
upgrades: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.
highlights: to give health to friendly Heroes

abilities.name: Soul Exchange
abilities.quip: Swap your current health with an enemy hero's
abilities.description: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
upgrades: On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.

abilities.name: Lightning Ball
abilities.quip: Launch a damaging ball of lightning
abilities.description: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius . Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
upgrades: -28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime
highlights: damage to all targets in its radius

abilities.name: Static Charge
abilities.quip: Apply a delayed area stun to an enemy hero
abilities.description: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: Power Surge
abilities.quip: Create electric arcs with your shots
abilities.description: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target . This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
upgrades: +3m Move Speed +8 Damage and increased scaling
highlights: your bullets proc shock damage on your target

abilities.name: Storm Cloud
abilities.quip: Fry all enemies in a large area
abilities.description: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
upgrades: +55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
+7s Channel Time +10m Final Radius +5m Initial Radius

abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
abilities.quip: Put an enemy to sleep
abilities.description: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
upgrades: -10% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6s on wake-up
-17s Cooldown -40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.quip: Fade out of sight
abilities.description: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed . Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
upgrades: Dispels non-ult debuffs Grants +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

abilities.name: Fixation
abilities.quip: Deal increasing bullet damage to a target
abilities.description: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target . Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
upgrades: 40 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
+0.11 / per Stack Scales with Weapon Damage
highlights: increases your bullet damage on that target

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.quip: Unleash a flurry of bullets around you
abilities.description: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

abilities.name: Stake
abilities.quip: Tether your enemies to the ground
abilities.description: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.quip: Take flight and empower your weapon
abilities.description: Leap into the air and fly . While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
upgrades: Hero Kills Refresh Duration. +10 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Crow Familiar
abilities.quip: Make a target bleed over time
abilities.description: Your crow familiar deals impact damage , reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health .

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.quip: Snipe injured targets for massive damage

Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage .

abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
abilities.quip: Stun all nearby enemies after a short delay

abilities.name: Flame Dash

abilities.name: Napalm

upgrades: Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing

abilities.name: Afterburn
abilities.quip: Shoot enemies to set them on fire
abilities.description: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time . Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

abilities.name: Arctic Beam
abilities.quip: Apply an escalating slow

upgrades: -20% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.

abilities.name: Ice Path

+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

abilities.name: Frost Grenade

+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

abilities.name: Grapple
abilities.quip: Use your whip to pull yourself to an enemy

+1 Charges OnCast : +1 Stamina and +60% Air Control

abilities.name: Ground Strike

upgrades: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

abilities.name: Death Slam
abilities.quip: Lift enemies and smash them into the ground

Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed . Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.
upgrades: Stun enemies in Radius for 1.2s +6m Cast Range

abilities.name: Flog
abilities.quip: Heals from targets ahead of you

abilities.name: Dust Devil

abilities.description: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies , slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion .

abilities.name: Djinn's Mark
abilities.quip: Apply marks of escalating damage

-0.75s Cooldown +1 Max Marks Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks

abilities.name: Fire Scarabs

abilities.name: Traveler

abilities.name: Scorn
abilities.quip: Damage enemies nearby, healing from each hit

abilities.name: Crimson Slash
abilities.quip: Damage enemies nearby, healing on hit
abilities.description: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate . If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal .
upgrades: On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal
highlights: damaging them and slowing their fire rate

abilities.name: Shadow Transformation
abilities.quip: Become invincible and more powerful
abilities.description: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster . You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist . When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
highlights: abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster

abilities.name: Slither
abilities.quip: Increase the agility of your Slide
abilities.description: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

abilities.name: Lethal Venom
abilities.quip: Inject your enemies with a deadly venom
abilities.description: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage . The damage is increased by the target's missing health. Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
upgrades: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

abilities.name: Screwjab Dagger
abilities.quip: Throw a slowing dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow . Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow .
upgrades: On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
+ 2 Max Stacks -2s Charge Delay On Hit: Refund 55% Charge Cooldown

abilities.name: Petrifying Bola
abilities.quip: Toss a petrifying bola
abilities.description: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
upgrades: + 1s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Vexing Bolt
abilities.quip: Launch a guided bolt of magic
abilities.description: Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage , increasing as it travels . If you have an Assistant , they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.
upgrades: Bolts apply -25% Fire Rate for 5 s.

abilities.name: Spectral Assistant
abilities.quip: Summon your faithful assistant
abilities.description: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage . While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant . Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

abilities.name: Audience Participation
abilities.quip: Copy an enemy's Ultimate for a limited time
abilities.description: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead. Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points. Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

abilities.name: Rabbit Hex
abilities.description: Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and move faster , but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions . Hex does not interrupt abilities.

abilities.name: Sanguine Retreat
abilities.description: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.
upgrades: On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets

abilities.name: Love Bites
abilities.description: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage . Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite , dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage . Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
upgrades: +3 Spirit Damage per Bullet & +45 Bonus Damage
-5 Cooldown On Proc: +25% Fire Rate for 5s

abilities.name: Nox Nostra
abilities.description: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence . Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
upgrades: On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Rake
upgrades: +7% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Jumpstart
abilities.description: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed , decaying over time.
upgrades: +1 Charge +50% Debuff Resistance Increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Aura of Suffering
abilities.description: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
upgrades: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

abilities.name: Shocking Reanimation
abilities.description: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow . After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
upgrades: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6 Spirit Damage per Bullet

abilities.name: Pain Battery
abilities.description: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Bookwyrm
abilities.description: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.description: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow . The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize .
upgrades: +2m Radius On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.description: Grant an ally a barrier . While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage .
upgrades: Affects up to 2 additional allies. Increases barrier scaling.

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.description: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city , healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

abilities.name: Doorway
abilities.description: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
upgrades: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance and scales with Spirit Power.

abilities.name: Luggage Cart
abilities.description: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
upgrades: +25m Cast Range +75 Damage on wall impact
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact

abilities.name: Call Bell
abilities.description: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow . Can be shot to detonate early.

abilities.name: Hotel Guest
abilities.description: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage . Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage .
upgrades: +150 Damage +1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied. 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.description: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
upgrades: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.description: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage . The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
upgrades: +5m Range +1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.description: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.
highlights: send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.description: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage . The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup .
upgrades: -3s Charge Time Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage . If the enemy is in close range , deal bonus melee damage .
upgrades: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage Silences enemies for 2s if close range

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.description: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time . While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

abilities.name: Bloodscent
upgrades: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.description: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units . Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain bonus sprint speed .
highlights: severely limiting their vision of other units

abilities.name: Gutshot
abilities.description: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage .
upgrades: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

abilities.name: Ira Domini
abilities.description: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes , dealing massively increased weapon damage . The final stake is blessed , dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
upgrades: While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed

abilities.name: Consecrating Grenade
abilities.description: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing .

abilities.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
abilities.description: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage , applying immobilize , and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
upgrades: +1 Charge Deal +30% damage against revealed targets

abilities.name: Pillow Toss
abilities.description: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback . Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

abilities.name: Naptime
abilities.description: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage .
upgrades: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling
highlights: slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.

abilities.name: Lil Helpers
abilities.description: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed . Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.
highlights: healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along.

abilities.name: Tag Along
abilities.description: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration . Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
upgrades: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.description: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
upgrades: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.description: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist . Press Ability 2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
upgrades: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.description: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage . Press Ability 3 to re-cast.
upgrades: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling. Increased lunge speed & distance.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.description: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage , dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.description: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize . Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.description: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
upgrades: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup

abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
upgrades: On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.description: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
upgrades: +1 Max Steal Targets All Summons now apply Essence Theft

abilities.name: Slam Fire
abilities.description: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
upgrades: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage

abilities.name: Boot Kick
upgrades: +80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

abilities.name: Entangling Bola
abilities.description: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage , applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
upgrades: +0.75s Debuff Duration. Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

abilities.name: Lycan Curse
abilities.description: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health , and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
upgrades: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.description: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal .

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.description: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
upgrades: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.description: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.description: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.
upgrades: +4% Spirit Amp per Stack +9% Fire Rate per Stack

abilities.name: Living Ink
upgrades: On Empower: Gain +10% Fire Rate for 10s, stacking 5 times
+1s Cooldown Reduction Per Hit Improve scaling

abilities.name: Flow State
abilities.description: Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading slow and spirit damage to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels. Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing spirit damage in a larger area.
upgrades: On Slide: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 20% for 6s

abilities.name: Still Life
abilities.description: Choose a hero to be your subject , dealing spirit damage over time as long as you are looking at them. If the sketch is completed they take additional spirit damage , suffer from stun , and drop a sketch that can be picked up. For each collected sketch , you permanently gain stats based on the hero.
upgrades: On Cast: Gain 15 Health Regen for 4s, refreshed on pickup

abilities.name: Abstract Landscape
abilities.description: Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies Spirit . Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take spirit damage and suffer from Silence and slow , destroying the ink in the process.
upgrades: On Buff: +25% Spirit Lifesteal +15 Spirit Power
+1.25s Silence Duration +4s Ability Duration Ink is no longer destroyed

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.quip: Threadsap
abilities.description: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing spirit damage and stealing enemy Spirit , increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen Spirit , Baba deals bonus spirit damage with every bullet.

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.quip: Granny Long Legs: jump high and kick anyone nearby with spirit-charged legs.
abilities.description: Your bench's legs extend, granting bonus move speed , higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance . Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies knockup , slow , and deals spirit damage . Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.quip: Brew Baba's special pot of tea, then throw it to ignite or silence enemies, or shield allies
abilities.description: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time between a soothing barrier , Silence , or scalding burn that deals spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist . Press to pause or resume brewing.

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.description: Cover targets in front of you with bread , adding a stacking slow . When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon , increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.
upgrades: +125 Max Damage +125 Spirit Scaling +0.5s Max Duration

abilities.name: Setup Bishop
abilities.description: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move ( ): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing spirit damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional spirit damage when stepped on. Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.
upgrades: +1 Square Range Squares reduce Spirit Resist by -2.5%, stacking 10 times

abilities.name: Kingside Knight
abilities.description: Promote an ally to be a knight , granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration. If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move ( ): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.
upgrades: Can target two allies within radius. On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

abilities.name: Rook Battery
abilities.description: Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize . If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate : Split the rooks perpendicularly.
upgrades: On Hit: Reduce 25% Fire Rate for 5s
On Hit: 5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Develop Queen
upgrades: +15% Slow. Checkmates heroes below 200 health, executing them.

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.description: Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat. Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early. Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down. Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
On Hero Hit: -50% Cooldown and +120 Spirit Damage

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.description: Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing spirit damage and marking the target. Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow . Hold and drag to select the angle.
upgrades: +2 Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling
highlights: salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line.

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.description: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground. You and the participant take spirit damage over time while falling and spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.description: Spray fuel dealing weapon damage over time and shredding bullet resist , building up to a huge backblast that deals spirit damage and knocks you backwards. Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.
upgrades: +60 Burst Damage On Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s
-10% Bullet Resist Shred On Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

abilities.name: Leech Therapy
abilities.description: Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs .
upgrades: Leeches drain stamina and restore it to you on pickup
+1m Radius +0.3 Spirit Scaling +8 Max Leech Stacks
highlights: eating away at the duration of enemy buffs

abilities.name: Lurking Terrors
abilities.description: Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities . At max terror, they flee in fear away from you . Each leech you have collected adds fear duration . Enemies facing away from you take 50% damage unless feared.
upgrades: -20% Move Speed and Fire Rate +30 DPS
+3s Channel Time +0.5 Spirit Scaling Immune to damage while channeling
highlights: cannot use stamina or movement abilities
flee in fear away from you

abilities.name: Healing Needles
abilities.description: Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that heal allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them. Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip. Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.
upgrades: +20 Heal Per Shot Shots restore 0.6 stamina
+0.4 Spirit Scaling Shots extend non-ultimate buff durations by 6%, up to their max duration

abilities.name: Wretched Vapors
abilities.description: Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash. Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters. Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage . Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.
highlights: deal their delayed damage plus extra damage

abilities.name: Rat Swarm
abilities.description: Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target. Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash .
upgrades: +8 Damage and -1% Bullet Resist per Bite

abilities.name: Scrap Grenade
abilities.description: Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow . The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.
upgrades: Add an additional final Bigger Detonation

abilities.name: Royal Pestments
abilities.description: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health . As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker. The barrier does not benefit from resists.
upgrades: Reduce all damage to a max of 250 +10% Max Health as Barrier

abilities.name: Rule, Ratannia!
abilities.description: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed , immunity from slows , and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.description: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.description: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

items.name: Capacitor
items.description: Launch a projectile that deals damage , applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities .

items.name: Hollow Point
items.description: When you are above 65% health , deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist .

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.description: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.description: Your next Melee attack heals you . This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Rebuttal
items.description: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

items.name: Counterspell
items.description: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items . On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit .

items.name: Weighted Shots
items.description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

items.name: Long Range
items.description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Slowing Bullets
items.description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.description: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction .

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.description: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.description: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

items.name: Silence Wave
items.description: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

items.name: Silencer
items.description: Your bullets build up to a Silence . Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

items.name: Berserker
items.description: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.description: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage .

items.name: Weakening Headshot
items.description: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist .

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Headhunter
items.description: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage , heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed .

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.description: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing .

items.name: Mystic Shot
items.description: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage .

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.description: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

items.name: Point Blank
items.description: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow .

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.description: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

items.name: Ricochet
items.description: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.description: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.description: When below 50% health , gain additional Spirit Resist.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.description: When below 50% health , gain additional Bullet Resist .

items.name: Metal Skin
items.description: Become immune to bullets .

items.name: Healing Booster
items.description: Increases the effectiveness of your healing .

items.name: Fortitude
items.description: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.

items.name: Leech
items.description: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction .

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.description: Whenever you score an assist or kill , gain extra sprint , ability range and passive soul generation . This effect stacks and persists through death.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.description: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.description: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate . If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled .

items.name: Grit
items.description: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

items.name: Weapon Shielding
items.description: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.description: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.description: While you are above 65% health , gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate .

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.description: While you are above 65% health , gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction .

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.description: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration . Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.description: Gain bonus Fire Rate , Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.

items.name: Return Fire
items.description: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.description: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.description: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius .

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.description: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage .

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.description: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.description: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.description: When an enemy takes spirit damage , they have their spirit resist reduced.

items.name: Healbane
items.description: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing . If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

items.name: Mystic Slow
items.description: When the target takes spirit damage , they have their Move Speed reduced.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.description: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

items.name: Omnicharge Signet
items.description: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges . Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.description: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown .

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.description: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.description: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.description: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities . Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

items.name: Spirit Sap
items.description: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power .

items.name: Focus Lens
items.description: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

items.name: Rusted Barrel
items.description: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance .

items.name: Disarming Hex
items.description: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist .

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.description: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health . Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Decay
items.description: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

items.name: Scourge
items.description: Apply Spirit Resist , Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

items.name: Knockdown
items.description: Apply a Stun after 2s . Stun duration is increased against airborne targets. Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.description: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage , Move speed reduction and Disarm .

items.name: Warp Stone
items.description: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist .

items.name: Refresher
items.description: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges .

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.description: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.description: Become Stealthed . Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

items.name: Majestic Leap
items.description: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier . While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

items.name: Healing Nova
items.description: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

items.name: Healing Rite
items.description: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Shrink Ray
items.description: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Infuser
items.description: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power .

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.description: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed . Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.description: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed . Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.description: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist . 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.description: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate , Debuff Resistance and Move Speed .

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.description: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.description: After you Dash-Jump , the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power .

items.name: Unstoppable
items.description: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm . Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept .

items.name: Colossus
items.description: Grow larger in size , gaining bullet resist , spirit resist , and melee damage . Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed .

items.name: Cold Front
items.description: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.description: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage , Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.description: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.description: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming , and preventing item usage . Removes all non-ultimate buffs . Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.description: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration .

items.name: Superior Duration
items.description: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.description: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.description: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount. This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.description: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist . Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.description: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power . Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.description: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage .

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.description: Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned .

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.description: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power .

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.description: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.description: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits a hero.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.description: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power . When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

items.name: Suppressor
items.description: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate .

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.description: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.description: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage , bonus fire rate , and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.description: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

items.name: Escalating Resilience
items.description: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit a hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.description: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth , Heal and increased Move Speed .

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.description: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced .

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.description: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

items.name: Split Shot
items.description: Make your weapon fire multishot . Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus . Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

items.name: Active Reload
items.description: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate , Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed .

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.description: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.description: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.description: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

items.name: Witchmail
items.description: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown .

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.description: Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed . Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.description: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance .

items.name: Infinite Rounds
items.description: You have infinite ammo.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.description: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.description: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.description: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

items.name: Stalker
items.description: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed . Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time , have reduced bullet resist , and are revealed through walls .

items.name: Express Shot
items.description: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

items.name: Seraphim Wings
items.description: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

items.name: Mystical Piano
items.description: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

items.name: Nullification Burst
items.description: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

items.name: Celestial Blessing
items.description: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

items.name: Eternal Gift
items.description: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

items.name: Mystic Conduit
items.description: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

items.name: Haunting Shot
items.description: Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals bonus spirit damage based on the target's current Health. The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

items.name: Cloak of Opportunity
items.description: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable . Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed

items.name: Runed Gauntlets
items.description: Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

items.name: Electric Slippers
items.description: When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you. Cooldown is per target.

items.name: Prism Blast
items.description: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

items.name: Unstable Concoction
items.description: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage . After a short duration you die and explode , stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50% .

items.name: Frostbite Charm
items.description: Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power . When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage . Cooldown is per target.

items.name: Shadow Strike
items.description: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time .

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.description: Imbue an ability with increased range . Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit . Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.description: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities .

items.name: Golden Goose Egg
items.description: Gain souls over time , as long as you are alive.
